listing.name: Pages by Form*
listing.summary: Private, encrypted notes and documents stored on the decentralized Nostr network — no servers, no surveillance, just your words.
listing.content:
Your notes aren’t just text — they’re your thoughts at 2AM, your plans for the future, your half-formed ideas that might become something real. Why should anyone else have access to that?

Pages by Form* is a private, end-to-end encrypted note-taking app built on the Nostr protocol. Your documents live on decentralized relays — not on any company’s servers — and only you hold the keys. Write freely, knowing that no platform can read, sell, or lose your notes.

- End-to-end encrypted — only you (and anyone you explicitly share with) can read your documents
- Decentralized — stored on Nostr relays, not locked into any single service
- Offline-first — write anywhere, sync when you’re connected
- Shareable — selectively share documents with specific Nostr users
- No account required — log in with your Nostr key, or generate one on the spot

want.about: Private, end-to-end encrypted notes and documents stored on Nostr relays, not on any company's servers, and only you hold the keys. Write offline and sync when connected, share documents with specific Nostr users, and log in with your Nostr key.

listing.name: SleepGuard
listing.content:
Do you often fall asleep while watching videos or listening to music on your phone? SleepGuard makes sure your device doesn't keep running all night long.

At an interval you choose, a small red circle appears on top of whatever you are watching. Tap it and playback continues as normal. Don't tap it within a few seconds - because you have fallen asleep - and SleepGuard locks the screen, just like pressing the power button. Your video stops and your phone is protected for the rest of the night.

There is also an Audio mode for music, audiobooks and podcasts: instead of a button, SleepGuard works as a simple sleep timer that stops playback after your chosen interval — even with the screen off.

WHY YOU NEED IT

* YouTube and other apps with autoplay: Without SleepGuard, one video starts the next and the next and the next ... until morning. In the worst case the battery is drained empty and your alarm can no longer go off when you need it. SleepGuard stops the chain as soon as you stop responding.

* Netflix, Prime Video and other streaming apps: Fall asleep mid-episode and you wake up not knowing where you dozed off. You waste time scrubbing back to find the spot - sometimes sitting through long ads again and again. SleepGuard locks the screen right when you don't respond, so your streaming app knows where to continue.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Set how often the check button should appear (e.g. every 5 minutes).
2. Set how many seconds you have to react before the screen locks (e.g. 30 seconds).
3. Choose where on the screen the button appears.
4. Start SleepGuard and keep watching.

FEATURES

* Two modes: Video (wake-check button over any app) and Audio (sleep timer for music, audiobooks and podcasts, works also with the screen off)
* Adjustable interval and reaction time
* Eight button positions to choose from
* Reliable timing even in the background (uses the system alarm)
* Completely free, no ads, no tracking, no accounts

PRIVACY

SleepGuard has NO internet permission at all. It cannot send or receive any data. It does exactly two things: show a button and lock the screen. It collects nothing.

PERMISSIONS EXPLAINED

* Display over other apps: to show the red circle on top of your video.
* Device admin (screen lock only): to lock the screen like the power button.
* Foreground service & exact alarm: to make the check button appear on time.
* Ignore battery optimization: so the button still works reliably while another app is in the foreground.
* Notifications (Android 13+): to show the ongoing "SleepGuard is active" notification.

OPEN SOURCE

SleepGuard is free software, licensed under the GNU General Public License v3. The full source code is available so anyone can inspect exactly what the app does: https://github.com/OlafDrechsler/SleepGuard

SUPPORT

SleepGuard is free and will stay free. If it helps you, you can support its developer with a voluntary donation from within the app. There is deliberately no reward in return - it is simply a thank-you.

THE IDEA / THE NAME

The idea for the app comes from a safety system used on trains. In the driver’s cab, there is a button that the driver must press at regular intervals, otherwise the train will automatically stop. By pressing the button, the driver confirms that he or she is awake. Colloquially, this button is called a “dead man’s switch,” and so the app is also called “SleepGuard – dead man’s switch.”

want.about: Locks the screen when you fall asleep watching videos. At an interval you choose, a small red circle appears, and if you don't tap it within a few seconds, playback stops. An Audio mode works as a sleep timer for music, audiobooks and podcasts.

listing.name: Quiet Dial
listing.content:
Is your Android volume still too loud even at the lowest setting, on calls, media, or notifications? Your phone or tablet stops at its hardware minimum. Granular Volume goes below it.

A small floating control appears above any app, with your whole volume range on one slider: normal system volume above your device's minimum line, and a quiet zone below it, seven steps down to a full 30 dB under the hardware minimum. Drag it anywhere, tuck it to an edge, close it when done. Your position is saved.

This is a convenience utility, not hearing protection equipment. Actual loudness depends on your device and headphones, so use good judgment with volume changes.

LOWER THAN YOUR PHONE OR TABLET ALLOWS
Most volume apps are built to go louder. Granular Volume is built for the other end: it reduces volume below the lowest step your device's hardware allows, using Android's audio engine, on phones and tablets alike. No root required. No system volume panel replacement. No ads, no account, no internet permission at all. The quiet zone is the heart of the app, and the same slider covers your normal range too.

WHEN YOUR VOLUME BUTTONS DO NOT WORK
Volume keys wear out, stiffen, or get held down by a case. Above the line marking your device's minimum, the dial sets normal system volume, so it stands in for the buttons: drag up for louder, drag down for quieter, in even 5 dB steps built from your own device's volume curve. Below the line it keeps going, quieter than the phone allows. A mute control silences media without touching your alarms.

BUILT FOR TABLETS TOO
Tablets often have an even higher minimum volume than phones. Granular Volume works the same way on Android tablets, so tablet users get the same quiet floor.

A FLOATING VOLUME CONTROL, ALWAYS IN REACH
The control lives above whatever you are doing. Open any app, start any audio, and it is there when you need it. Drag it anywhere, or tuck it to an edge between uses. One tap closes it. Your last position is remembered next time.

QUICK SETTINGS TILE
Swipe down, tap once. Add Granular Volume to your Quick Settings panel and toggle the overlay on or off without ever opening the app. No shortcuts to set up, no widgets to place.

MADE FOR QUIET MOMENTS
- Phone and app calls on most phones. A few devices route call audio in hardware, where no app can reach it
- Sensitive IEMs and high-sensitivity headphones, where even step 1 is too loud
- Tablet speakers and headphones, where the minimum step is often even louder than on phones
- White noise or lullabies for a sleeping baby, kept barely audible
- Late-night listening next to a sleeping partner
- Quiet rooms, libraries, open offices, and meditation
- ASMR and relaxation audio at a comfortable level
- Hearing aids and amplified devices where minimum system volume is too strong

DESIGNED TO STAY OUT OF THE WAY
Granular Volume does not take over your volume keys: they keep working, and inside the quiet zone the dial folds their presses into its own finer scale. It does not replace your system volume panel and it does not add an equalizer suite you did not ask for. It sits quietly on top as an overlay and changes one thing: the level, from normal volume all the way below your hardware minimum.

FREE, PRIVATE, OPEN SOURCE
No ads. No tracking. No internet permission, so the app cannot connect to anything. No account, no sign in, no analytics. Open source under the GPL-3.0 license.

PERMISSIONS, EXPLAINED
- Display over other apps: required to show the floating volume control above your screen
- Modify audio settings: required to apply the volume attenuation
- Run a foreground service: keeps the control reliable while you listen
- Start on boot: restores the control after a restart if it was on before shutdown, so it is ready when you need it

Works on Android phones and tablets alike. If your minimum was always too loud, this is the volume you were missing.

want.about: Lowers volume below your device's hardware minimum. A small floating slider above any app covers your whole volume range, with a quiet zone seven steps down to 30 dB under the minimum. No root required.

listing.name: DistroHopper
listing.content:

Features include a couple of different themes, a search feature which allows you to search from a multitude of different search sources (both local and remote), and customisation options.

An optional gesture lets you swipe to open your notification tray. If you have any suggestions or feedback, feel free to get in touch. The project is open-source with the source code publicly available at https://github.com/RobinJ1995/DistroHopper. If you're less technically-inclined but would still like to contribute, you can join the project's translation team over at https://www.transifex.com/distrohopper/.

listing.name: Infinity+
listing.content:
Tired of ads and algorithms? **Infinity for Reddit** is the fast, open-source **Reddit app** built to give you back control. Experience a clean, customizable, and ad-free **Reddit client** that lets you browse, post, and engage with your favorite communities exactly the way you want.

Infinity is built for performance and transparency. As a community-driven **Reddit client**, we focus on privacy and user control. You can verify our security by checking our source code: https://github.com/Docile-Alligator/Infinity-For-Reddit

### Full Reddit Engagement

• **Full-Featured Experience**: Unlike read-only viewers, Infinity is a full-featured Reddit app.
• **Log in & Sync**: Sign in to your account to sync your subreddits and preferences.
• **Post & Comment**: Share text, images, videos, and polls. Reply to threads with embedded images and GIFs.
• **Vote & Save**: Upvote content and save posts directly to your Reddit account.
• **Multiple Accounts**: Easily switch between different profiles within the app.

### Your Feed, Your Rules

• **Custom Feeds**: Organize your favorite subreddits into specialized groups (Multireddits).
• **Advanced Filtering**: Hide posts by keywords, flair, or author to keep your Reddit feed clean.
• **Media Downloader**: Save videos, GIFs, and images from any Reddit post directly to your device.
• **Smart Layouts**: Choose between compact, card, or gallery views.

### Superb Anonymous Mode

Browse Reddit with true privacy. Infinity offers an enhanced Anonymous Mode that goes beyond simple logged-out viewing.
• **Local Engagement**: Save, hide, and even "vote" on posts. All activity is stored securely on your device, never on Reddit’s servers.
• **Anonymous Subscriptions**: Follow users and subreddits privately.
• **Read Tracking**: Keep track of which Reddit posts you’ve already seen without a profile.
• **Custom Anonymous Feeds**: Build unique feeds that only exist on your phone.
• **No Account Required**: Enjoy a full-featured Reddit app experience without ever linking your activity to a username.

### Deep Customization

The most customizable Reddit client available.
• **Endless Themes**: Light, Dark, and true AMOLED Black for battery saving.
• **Custom Gestures**: Tailor swipes and long-presses to your browsing style.
• **Customizable UI**: Change fonts, colors, and tab layouts.

### Subscription & Support

Due to recent changes to the Reddit API, a subscription is required to log in and access your account features. Your support helps keep this Reddit app ad-free, privacy-focused, and actively maintained. Note: Limited anonymous browsing is still available. Due to platform limitations, anonymous browsing without a subscription may occasionally fail to load content. A subscription provides consistent access in anonymous mode.

Join our community at **r/Infinity_For_Reddit**: https://www.reddit.com/r/Infinity_For_Reddit/

### Disclaimer

Infinity is an independent third-party Reddit client. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Reddit. It accesses publicly available content through Reddit’s official API in accordance with their terms.

want.about: Ad-free, customizable Reddit client to browse, post, comment, vote, and save. Sign in to sync your subreddits, switch between multiple accounts, and organize your favorite subreddits into custom feeds.

listing.name: Radar
listing.content:
Your messages. Your Bitcoin. Together, at last.

Radar is the first app to bring private messaging and self-custodial Bitcoin into one seamless experience. The two most personal things you do every day — who you talk to and what you do with your money — finally live in one place.

For too long it's taken two apps. One to send a private message. Another to send Bitcoin. Copy, paste, switch, repeat. Radar ends the shuffle.

Send sats like you send a text
No switching apps. No copy-paste. Just open a chat and send — settled instantly over the Bitcoin Lightning Network. Split dinner, cover a friend, send rent, or surprise someone you love, right inside the conversation.

Your people are already here
Radar is built on Signal's trusted messaging network, so the people you already talk to come with you. No rebuilding your network. No new account necessary.

A private messenger and a Bitcoin wallet, in one
• End-to-end encrypted — built on Signal's battle-tested protocol for encryption you can actually trust.
• Self-custodial wallet — your keys, your coins. Radar never holds your money; no one can freeze, seize, or lose it but you.
• Instant Bitcoin payments over the Lightning Network, settled in seconds.
• No ads or trackers. We don't sell ads and we don't track you. Your chats and payments are nobody's business but yours.
• Open source. Every line is open to inspect, audit, and build on — no black boxes.
• Always free. No subscriptions, no paid tiers, no hidden fees, for everyone, everywhere.

We even give back to the protocol we rely on — Signal's mission to keep private messaging alive is ours too.

The people you connect with. The money you trust. Together, at last.

want.about: Private messaging and self-custodial Bitcoin in one place. Open a chat and send sats like you send a text, settled instantly over the Bitcoin Lightning Network. Built on Signal's messaging network, so the people you already talk to are here.

listing.name: Jellyfin
listing.content:
Your media, on your terms.

This is the official Jellyfin companion app for Android.

The Jellyfin project is an open source, free software media server. No fees, no tracking, no hidden agenda. Get our free server to collect all your audio, video, photos, and more in one place.

To use the app, you must have a Jellyfin server set up and running. Find out more at https://jellyfin.org

With a Jellyfin server, you can:
- Watch Live TV and recorded shows from your Jellyfin server (additional hardware/services required)
- Stream to a Chromecast device on your network
- Stream your media to your Android device
- View your collection in an easy to use interface
- Listen to your music with Android Auto (online only)

Thank you for using Jellyfin!

want.about: Companion app for your own media server. Stream your media to your Android device, watch Live TV and recorded shows, stream to a Chromecast on your network, and listen to your music with Android Auto. Requires a server set up and running.

listing.name: PocketPal
listing.content:
Your AI. No one else's.

PocketPal runs large language models directly on your phone. No servers. No internet. No data leaves your device. Ever.

This is AI you own — not AI you rent.

WHAT YOUR PHONE NEEDS

Modern phones are powerful enough to run real AI. PocketPal uses that power.

You'll need 6GB+ RAM for smaller models, 8GB+ for the good stuff. Flagship and recent mid-range phones from the last 2-3 years run models well. Older or budget devices won't cut it — this is real inference, not a cloud wrapper.

Not sure? Download a small model and benchmark it. The app will show you exactly what your device can handle.

WHAT YOU GET

- Hundreds of open-source models from HuggingFace, downloaded directly to your device
- Complete offline operation — airplane mode, no signal, underground, anywhere
- Zero data transmission. Zero telemetry. Verify it yourself: we're open source
- Full control over model parameters — temperature, context length, system prompts
- Built-in benchmarking to test model performance on your hardware
- Metal acceleration on iOS, NNAPI on Android
- Pals — AI personas from Palshub.ai that give models personality and purpose

WHAT THIS IS NOT

This is not ChatGPT. Cloud AI has trillion-parameter models running on server farms. Your phone runs smaller models locally. The trade-off is real — and it's one we're proud of.

You get something no cloud service can offer: conversations that exist only on your device, AI that works without internet, and complete freedom to run any model you choose. No content policies imposed by us. No behavioral guardrails we decided for you. Your rules.

WHO THIS IS FOR

People who stopped trusting the cloud with their conversations. People who want AI that works on a plane, in a tunnel, off the grid. People who care about what runs on their own hardware.

If you're looking for the "best" AI at any cost and don't care about privacy — use ChatGPT. It's great at what it does.

If you want AI that's yours, PocketPal is how you get it.

OPEN SOURCE

Every line of code is public on GitHub. Our privacy claims aren't marketing — they're verifiable. If you don't trust us, read the source. That's the point.

want.about: Runs large language models directly on your phone with complete offline operation and no servers. Download hundreds of models from HuggingFace to your device and benchmark what it can handle. Needs 6GB+ RAM for smaller models.

listing.name: Mindwtr
listing.content:
Your head keeps reminding you of things at the worst times. Mindwtr gives them a safe home.

Mindwtr (pronounced "mind water") is a free, open-source to-do app built on the Getting Things Done (GTD) method. Write down every task and idea the moment it appears, sort it in seconds, and see only what you can do right now. No account, no subscription, and your data stays on your device.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Dump it. A task, an idea, a worry: type it or speak it, and it lands in your Inbox.
2. Sort it. A short guided pass: do it now, schedule it, hand it off, or shelve it for someday.
3. Do it. The Focus view shows only what you can act on right now, nothing else.
4. Reset weekly. A guided review catches loose ends, so the list stays trustworthy and your head stays clear.

New to GTD? The idea is simple: your head is for having ideas, not for holding them. Mindwtr walks you through every step.

WHY MINDWTR

- Works completely offline. No account required.
- Your tasks stay on your device. Sync is optional and you choose where: Dropbox, a folder you control, WebDAV, your own server, or iCloud on Apple devices.
- The full GTD method built in: Inbox, Next, Waiting For, Someday/Maybe, Projects, Areas, Contexts, and reviews.
- Capture from anywhere: quick add, widgets, sharing from other apps, or voice.
- Plan your way: list, calendar, and kanban board views.
- Reminders, repeating tasks, checklists, Markdown notes, and attachments.
- Import from Todoist, TickTick, OmniFocus, and more.
- Free and open source. No ads or lock-in.

SIMPLE BY DEFAULT, POWERFUL WHEN YOU NEED IT

Fewer fields, fewer knobs, no clutter. Advanced tools, like the kanban board, automation, and an optional AI assistant that uses your own AI account, stay out of sight until you want them.

Mindwtr means "mind like water": the calm you get when nothing is rattling around in your head.

want.about: To-do app built on the Getting Things Done (GTD) method. Write down every task and idea in your Inbox, sort it in seconds, and use the Focus view to see only what you can do right now. A guided weekly review catches loose ends.

listing.name: Calendar
listing.content:
Tired of cluttered calendars and privacy concerns?

Fossify Calendar is here to change that. Your open-source powerhouse for managing life, designed with privacy as its core and packed with powerful features to keep you organized.

Here's what makes Fossify Calendar different:

🚫 AD-FREE AND PRIVATE:
Your events remain yours. No ads, no tracking, no intrusive permissions.

⏰ FLEXIBLE AND CUSTOMIZABLE:
Craft events precisely with times, durations, reminders, and advanced repetition rules.

🔄 SEAMLESS SYNCING:
Sync effortlessly with Google Calendar, Outlook, Nextcloud, Exchange, and more.

🎨 PERSONALIZE YOUR PLANNER:
Set custom sounds, looping audio streams, vibrations, and themes to match your preferences.

🌈 VIBRANT WIDGETS:
Brighten your day with beautiful calendar widgets and themes for your home screen.

📅 EFFORTLESS DAY MANAGEMENT:
Plan your day with ease, whether you're a busy professional or a family organizer.

🎉 IMPORT CELEBRATIONS:
Never miss a birthday or anniversary! Easily import holidays and special dates.

🔍 FILTER VIEWS:
Quickly find what you're looking for with event filters.

📆 MULTIPLE VIEWS:
Switch between daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, and event views effortlessly.

✨ MATERIAL DESIGN ELEGANCE:
Enjoy an intuitive and user-friendly interface with dynamic themes.

listing.name: SearchLauncher
listing.content:
Your home screen opens with a keyboard. One bar finds everything on your phone and everything on the web, and opens what you find in a browser that blocks ads.

SEARCH ANYTHING
Apps, app shortcuts, contacts, device settings, downloads, calendar events for the coming week, text snippets and your own custom actions. Ranking learns from what you pick, so the next time is faster.

SEARCH INSIDE APPS, NOT JUST FOR THEM
Type y for YouTube, m for Maps, w for Wikipedia, then what you are looking for. Add a shortcut for any site with a search URL, and give it whatever letter you like.

ONE FIELD THAT KNOWS WHAT YOU TYPED
A sum gets an answer you can tap to copy. A web address opens. "5m pasta" sets a timer. A phone number offers to call it, message it, or save it as a contact. An email address offers to write to it.

A BROWSER WITH NO ADS
Web results open in the app, with ads and trackers blocked by default. Swipe the search bar sideways to move between tabs, or up to see them all as live previews. Both work from the home screen, so your tabs are one gesture away without opening a browser first. Save a page under a title you choose, and find visited pages back from the search bar. Private windows, file uploads, picture-in-picture video and hardware keyboard shortcuts are all included.

FEWER ICONS, MORE ROOM FOR WIDGETS
Add a widget by typing its name, resize it by dragging, and tap the wallpaper to show or hide them all. On a tablet they lay out in columns rather than one widget stretched across the display.

MAKE IT YOURS
Swipe through your own wallpapers. The theme colour can follow the wallpaper behind the search bar. Monochrome icons are optional. Dark mode, a true black OLED mode, a row of favourites, voice search, and export and import of everything you have set up.

Use it as your default launcher, or as a widget on the launcher you already have.

PRIVACY
Nothing is sent anywhere by default. Search suggestions are optional, and when you turn them on, what you type goes to whichever provider the shortcut names. Crash reporting is opt-in. Contacts, calendar entries and photos are read on your device to answer what you typed and are never uploaded. The browser's blocklist is downloaded from the StevenBlack hosts project.

SearchLauncher is free and open source: https://github.com/ontola/searchlauncher

listing.name: PennyWise AI - Expense Tracker
listing.content:
Your bank already texts you every transaction. PennyWise reads those SMS on your phone and turns them into an automatic expense tracker — no manual entry, no sign-up, nothing uploaded.

★ Why PennyWise asks for SMS permission
Reading bank SMS is how the app works — it is the entire product. Everything happens on your device: no server ever receives a message, there is no account to create, and the complete source code is public (AGPL-3.0) so anyone can verify exactly what it does. Would rather not grant it? You can still add transactions by hand or import a PDF statement.

★ Automatic expense tracking
• Every UPI payment, card swipe, ATM withdrawal and bank transfer becomes a categorized transaction
• 141 banks and payment services across 23 countries, with multi-currency support
• Works with any UPI app — it reads your bank's SMS, not the app
• A clean, searchable spending timeline that stays up to date on its own

★ Budgets and insights
• Set monthly budgets per category and watch progress as you spend
• Spending trends, category breakdowns and month-on-month comparisons
• Automatic subscription detection — finds the recurring payments you forgot about
• Smart rules to auto-categorize transactions your way

★ On-device AI assistant
Ask "what did I spend on food last month?" and get a real answer. The AI model (Qwen 2.5) runs locally on your phone — no API calls, no cloud, works offline.

★ Private by design
• No account, no login, no email required
• No ads, no trackers, no analytics on your financial data
• Nothing leaves your device
• Open source (AGPL-3.0) — read the code yourself

★ Free, with optional Pro
PennyWise is free to use. An optional Pro upgrade adds unlimited custom rules, PDF statement imports, CSV export and duplicate-account merge — and directly supports a solo developer building PennyWise independently.

A money manager, budget planner and spending tracker in one — for people who hate typing in expenses.

listing.name: Lost My Phone
listing.summary: Text a secret phrase and it'll ring even on Silent or DND.
listing.content:
Lost your phone? …and it's on Silent or DND?
Text your secret phrase and make it ring anyway. Pick the sound, volume, and how long it rings.

listing.name: My Signet
listing.summary: Family identity and signing for the Signet protocol — your keys never leave your device
listing.content:
My Signet is client-side identity for the Signet protocol: verify who you
are once, then sign in to sites and services without passwords, emails or
accounts. Everything lives encrypted on your device — there is no backend
and no key ever leaves the phone.

Built for families. Guardians create dependant identities for their kids,
pair the apps they use, and approve or deny signing requests as they
happen — with an audit trail both sides can see. Autonomy grows in stages
as the child does.

The Android app adds what the web app structurally can't: fingerprint
unlock backed by the hardware Keystore, an always-on NIP-46 bunker that
keeps serving signing requests with the screen off, and notifications when
a request needs your decision.

No Google Play services, no Firebase, no analytics. Built GrapheneOS-first.

listing.name: Acode
listing.content:
Acode is an open-source code editor and web IDE for Android. Edit projects, manage files, use a Linux terminal, work with Git and SSH, and extend your setup with community plugins.

LINUX TERMINAL

Acode includes an Alpine Linux terminal powered by proot, with no root required. Use apk to install supported command-line packages, keep multiple terminal tabs, customize your shell, and back up or restore your terminal setup.

AI CODING SUPPORT

Use the terminal and plugin ecosystem with AI-assisted coding tools where supported. Generate code, review errors, refactor files, and ask for explanations while working from your phone or tablet.

JAVASCRIPT AND WEB DEVELOPMENT

Set up mobile web projects with Node.js and npm, run package scripts, build APIs with server-side JavaScript, preview HTML and Markdown, and test front-end projects inside Acode.

PROFESSIONAL CODE EDITOR

- Syntax highlighting for 100+ programming languages
- Multi-file editing with tabs
- Command palette (Ctrl+Shift+P)
- File search across projects (Ctrl+P)
- Code completion and IntelliSense via LSP plugins
- Keyboard shortcuts for common editor actions
- Emmet support for fast HTML and CSS authoring
- Interactive JavaScript console for debugging
- Live HTML and Markdown preview
- Customizable themes and fonts
- Smooth editing for large files

GIT, SSH AND REMOTE TOOLS

- Git workflows including clone, commit, push, pull and branch management
- SSH access for remote server work
- FTP and SFTP file management
- GitHub integration for project sync
- Tools for editing, previewing and deploying web projects from Android

COMMUNITY PLUGINS

Extend Acode with plugins from the in-app Plugin Store:
- Language servers for IntelliSense
- Themes and icon packs
- AI-assisted coding tools
- Build tools and formatters
- Framework support for modern web development
- JavaScript and TypeScript plugin development

OPEN SOURCE

Acode is free and open source under the MIT license. Source code is available at github.com/Acode-Foundation/Acode. Documentation and community links are available at acode.app.

Pro version is available with ad removal and premium themes. In-app purchases may vary by region.

GET STARTED

1. Install Acode
2. Open the terminal and complete the one-time setup
3. Install the packages and plugins you need
4. Start editing, previewing and managing projects from your Android device

Acode requires Android 7.0+. The free version contains ads.

listing.name: DNSNet
listing.content:
DNSNet allows you to take more control over what internet traffic goes in and out of your device. You can download host files to block a set of known advertising or malicious host names and then create exemptions where you see fit.

It works by creating a lightweight VPN service that filters your internet traffic as you use your device. If you ever have trouble with connecting to a site or using an app, you can always exempt an app from filtering or create an exception for a specific host name.

listing.name: Briar
listing.content:
Briar is a messaging app designed for activists, journalists, and anyone else who needs a safe, easy and robust way to communicate.

Unlike traditional messaging apps, Briar doesn't rely on a central server - messages are synchronized directly between the users' devices.

If the Internet's down, Briar can sync via Bluetooth or Wi-Fi, keeping the information flowing in a crisis. If the Internet's up, Briar can sync via the Tor network, protecting users and their relationships from surveillance.

You can link Briar with a device running Briar Mailbox (even on Android: https://f-droid.org/packages/org.briarproject.mailbox/) to receive encrypted messages from your contacts while Briar is offline.

listing.name: Aisleron
listing.content:
Streamline your shopping with this intuitive, easy-to-use shopping list app. Whether you’re preparing for a weekly grocery run or shopping for a special occasion, this app helps you stay organized and efficient.

Key Features:
* Create Custom Shops & Aisles: Add your favorite stores, categorize items by aisles, and easily organize your shopping list based on your local layout.
* Smart Product Management: Add products to your list and assign them to the appropriate area in your home. Rearrange products by aisle within each store to match your shopping route.
* Swipe-to-Track: Keep track of your shopping progress with a simple swipe. Swipe left or right to mark items as “Needed” or “In Stock.”
* Show on Lock Screen: No need to unlock your screen at the end of each aisle. Your shopping list will be displayed over the lock screen for convenience.
* Easy Editing: Long-press any item to edit or delete it.
* Loyalty Cards: Integrate with Catima — Loyalty Card Wallet to quickly open your store loyalty card.

Why you’ll love it:
* Stay organized by shopping smarter.
* Reduce time spent navigating the store.
* Never forget an item again — track everything you need with ease.
* Light and Dark themes.
* Free, no ads.
* Everything is done on the local device, no sharing of location data or shopping habits.

Get started today and make your shopping trips faster and more efficient!

listing.name: SunApp
listing.summary: Sun times and solar alarms for anywhere on Earth, computed entirely offline
listing.content:
SunApp calculates sunrise, solar noon and sunset for any location on Earth,
handles the timezone properly, and says plainly when the sun does not rise or
set at all.

It can also wake you by the sun rather than by the clock. Set an alarm for six
hours before solar noon, or eight hours after sunrise, and it recomputes every
day as the seasons move. When you build a rule it shows you the next thirty
days of fire times, so a rule that drifts to the afternoon in December is
visible when you set it rather than discovered in November. During polar night
it falls back to solar noon and tells you why.

It never touches the network. There is no INTERNET permission, so it cannot,
and there is no location permission either: coordinates come from a bundled
catalogue of 25,007 cities or from numbers you type. Check for yourself:

    aapt dump permissions SunApp-v1.1.0.apk

The nine permissions you will see are for the alarm feature and are documented
one sentence each in the repository README. Sun times need none of them, and no
dialog appears until you create your first alarm.

- Search 25,007 cities, accent-insensitive in both directions: "tromso" finds
  Tromso with the slash, "Herat" finds the one with the macron. English
  exonyms work too, so "Gothenburg" finds Goteborg and "Cologne" finds Koln.
- Every city carries its own IANA timezone. Times render in the place's zone,
  not your phone's.
- Any date, past or future.
- Midnight Sun and Polar Night are detected geometrically and labelled, not
  shown as a blank or an error.

The same maths and the same catalogue run on the web at sun.stormberry.as, and
the Kotlin port is tested against a golden corpus generated from the JavaScript
one, so the two cannot silently disagree about when the sun comes up.

Built by Stormberry AS in Askoy, Norway, where the gap between a December
sunrise and a June one is nine and a half hours and the question stops being
academic.

want.about: Shows how the Android SDK connects to a vehicle with an integrated KUKSA Databroker to read data and interact with the actuators of the vehicle. The KUKSA framework is based on the COVESA Vehicle Signal Specification (VSS).

listing.name: Edge Gallery
listing.content:
AI Edge Gallery is the premier destination for running the world's most powerful open-source Large Language Models (LLMs) on your mobile device. Experience high-performance Generative AI directly on your hardware—fully offline, private, and lightning-fast.

Now Featuring: Gemma 4

This update brings official support for the newly released Gemma 4 family. As the centerpiece of this release, Gemma 4 allows you to test the cutting edge of on-device AI. Experience advanced reasoning, logic, and creative capabilities without ever sending your data to a server.

Core Features

- Agent Skills: Transform your LLM from a conversationalist into a proactive assistant. Use the Agent Skills tile to augment model capabilities with tools like Wikipedia for fact-grounding, interactive maps, and rich visual summary cards. You can even load modular skills from a URL or browse community contributions on GitHub Discussions.
- AI Chat with Thinking Mode: Engage in fluid, multi-turn conversations and toggle the new Thinking Mode to peek "under the hood." This feature allows you to see the model's step-by-step reasoning process, which is perfect for understanding complex problem-solving. Note: Thinking Mode currently works with supported models, starting with the Gemma 4 family.
- Ask Image: Use multimodal power to identify objects, solve visual puzzles, or get detailed descriptions using your device's camera or photo gallery.
- Audio Scribe: Transcribe and translate voice recordings into text in real-time using high-efficiency on-device language models.

Prompt Lab: A dedicated workspace to test different prompts and single-turn use cases with granular control over model parameters like temperature and top-k.
- Mobile Actions: Unlock offline device controls and automated tasks powered entirely by a finetune of FunctionGemma 270m.
- Tiny Garden: A fun, experimental mini-game that uses natural language to plant and harvest a virtual garden using a finetune of FunctionGemma 270m.
- Model Management & Benchmark: Gallery is a flexible sandbox for a wide variety of open-source models. Easily download models from the list or load your own custom models. Manage your model library effortlessly and run benchmark tests to understand exactly how each model performs on your specific hardware.
- 100% On-Device Privacy: All model inferences happen directly on your device hardware. No internet is required, ensuring total privacy for your prompts, images, and sensitive data.

Built for the Community

AI Edge Gallery is an open-source project designed for the developer community and AI enthusiasts alike. Explore our example features, contribute your own skills, and help shape the future of the on-device agent ecosystem.

Check out the source code on GitHub:
https://github.com/google-ai-edge/gallery

Note: This app is in active development. Performance is dependent on your device's hardware (CPU/GPU). For support or feedback, contact us at google-ai-edge-gallery-android-feedback@google.com

want.about: Run Large Language Models (LLMs) on your mobile device, fully offline. Chat with Thinking Mode, ask about images from your camera, transcribe and translate voice recordings, test prompts in Prompt Lab, and download and benchmark models.

listing.name: Relagent
listing.content:
Run a modern AI agent yourself without external services. You need just this app and a computer to run the Relagent Engine.

The goal of the Relagent project is an accessible solution for agentic AI services with full control over your data. Setting up your own installation should be within reach without considerable technical knowledge or financial investment. The software is designed to be resource-efficient without any hidden costs.

To get started, please have a look at the [project's readme](https://gitlab.com/RmMsr/relagent).

What Relagent brings you:

* 🗨️ Chat interface: Ask the assistant anything
* 🌐 Persistent sessions: Open new sessions and continue them on any device. Data stays on your systems only.
* 🎤 Speech Integration: Input and Output on device with about 40 languages
* ⚖️ Use any open-weights model: By using the very well established Open AI chat completions protocol you can choose the inference service that works best for you. No external service needed - but you can use one.
* 🔒️ API Key Authentication: Restrict access to your data. Combine with a HTTPS proxy or a VPN to protect your data while accessing it from anywhere.
* 🧰 Agentic tools (e.g. web search)

What you do *NOT need*:

* Register for a 3rd party service (unless you want to use a commercial LLM provider)
* Pay for any usage or access (but I appreciate donations)
* Fear that your data ends up in big data silos or model training

What you *CAN do*:

* Host the Relagent engine yourself (start on your computer, switch to permanent installation when you are ready)
* Run a Large Language Model yourself (needs just one additional app, several free options with or without graphical interface you can choose from)
* Protect the API with HTTPS, Basic Auth or using a VPN.

For more information:

* Find the [Relagent source code](https://gitlab.com/RmMsr/relagent) on GitLab.
* Have a look at the related Blog [Venkado.org](https://venkado.org/).
* Follow the author [@guesser@sigmoid.social](https://sigmoid.social/@guesser) on the Fediverse.

want.about: Run a modern AI agent yourself without external services, with just this app and a computer running the engine. Chat with the assistant, continue persistent sessions on any device, use speech in about 40 languages, and choose any open-weights model.
